# We Are Scaling Physical AI. Come Build What’s Next.

If you thrive on hard problems and want to see your work deployed across the wide array of autonomous systems, you belong here.

[About SiMa.ai](https://sima.ai/our-story/)

Our DNA

## People join—and stay—to help drive our innovative approach to scale physical AI.

01.

### End-to-End Ownership

We tackle complex challenges alongside the industry's top talent, with full ownership of hardware and software development from concept through production.

02.

### Maniacal Execution

We relentlessly pursue customer success through maniacal execution, taking bold swings fueled by a fearless “can-do” attitude.

03.

### Blind Trust and Integrity

We don't just talk about innovation; we live it daily by empowering our people to take true ownership and push boundaries.

What we offer

## Benefits and Perks

### Your Growth

#### Define the Future of AI

End-to-end ownership of the most innovative software and silicon platform for physical AI. From concept through deployment with tier 1 customers, come join the best technologists in the industry.

### Your Health

#### Comprehensive Coverage

Peace of mind for you and your family with complete health, dental, and vision coverage.

### Your Wealth

#### Competitive Compensation

We pay well for the best. Generous compensation includes salary and equity to share in our success.

Join the team
